pages.name: Water Hag
pages.text: A hunched swamp necrophage with long arms, curved claws and algae-matted hair. Base health: 60 HP.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Swamps and mangrove swamps, including compatible c:is_swamp biomes. Dark shores and shallow water, usually alone; occasionally a pair.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: Mud throw: up to12 blocks,4 base damage, Slowness I for4 seconds and Darkness for1.5 seconds; cooldown10–14 seconds. Claws:8 base damage, sometimes two strikes. Swamp ambush starts near water or mud.

pages.title: Tactics
pages.text: Watch the raised arm and dodge sideways before contact. Use solid cover against mud, avoid shallow-water ambushes. Necrophage oil:15% bonus; existing elixir also applies. World-day progression increases danger.

pages.title: Remains
pages.text: Swamp gland45%: universal monster-essence ingredient in existing alchemy. Muddy claw65%: monster-bone ingredient for bone dust and a material for future recipes. No new elixirs.
